name: krypto-terminal
description: A free, local-first Solana memecoin trading terminal. Discover, analyse and trade — with a live launch scanner and automation engine built in. Part of the Krypt free tools suite.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && node scripts/gen-fee-integrity.mjs && node scripts/gen-presence-integrity.mjs && node scripts/collect-licenses.mjs && vite build && node scripts/obfuscate-main.mjs && node scripts/harden-bytecode.mjs
scripts.test:launchlab: esbuild electron/engine/launchLabDecoder.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=test/.launchlab.mjs && esbuild electron/data/launchLabAccounts.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=test/.launchlabaccounts.mjs && node test/launchlab.live.mjs
scripts.test:boop: esbuild electron/engine/boopDecoder.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=test/.boop.mjs && esbuild electron/data/boopAccounts.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=test/.boopaccounts.mjs && esbuild electron/engine/boopWatcher.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --external:ws --outfile=test/.boopwatcher.mjs && node test/boop.live.mjs
scripts.test:jupiter: esbuild electron/engine/jupiterRoute.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --alias:electron=./test/electronstub.mjs --alias:@shared=./shared --external:ws --external:undici --banner:js="import{createRequire}from 'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=test/.jupiter.mjs && esbuild electron/system/signPolicy.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --alias:electron=./test/electronstub.mjs --alias:@shared=./shared --external:ws --external:undici --banner:js="import{createRequire}from 'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=test/.signpolicy.mjs && esbuild electron/system/netAgent.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --alias:electron=./test/electronstub.mjs --alias:@shared=./shared --external:ws --external:undici --banner:js="import{createRequire}from 'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=test/.netagent.mjs && node test/jupiter.live.mjs
scripts.test:prewarm: esbuild electron/engine/prewarm.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --alias:electron=./test/electronstub.mjs --alias:@shared=./shared --external:ws --external:undici --banner:js="import{createRequire}from 'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=test/.prewarm.mjs && esbuild electron/engine/confirmSocket.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --alias:electron=./test/electronstub.mjs --alias:@shared=./shared --external:ws --external:undici --banner:js="import{createRequire}from 'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=test/.confirmsocket.mjs && esbuild electron/system/netAgent.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --alias:electron=./test/electronstub.mjs --alias:@shared=./shared --external:ws --external:undici --banner:js="import{createRequire}from 'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=test/.netagent.mjs && node test/prewarm.live.mjs
